name: Wenxin Li
title: Designer
bio: Wenxin is a designer and creative technologist exploring the intersection of spatial computing, digital heritage, and interactive systems. Currently pursuing an MLA at Harvard GSD, her work focuses on translating complex spatial data, archaeological narratives, and emerging technologies into meaningful interactive experiences. She has led and contributed to projects spanning XR storytelling, geospatial platforms, and AI-assisted design tools, and is part of the organizing team for the Harvard XR Conference. Her practice bridges design, technology, and cultural narratives to rethink how we experience space in the age of spatial computing.
